basic_info.description: Spacious and light-filled live/work loft at Iron Works offers dramatic volume and versatile design in a boutique 28-unit elevator building. Residence #1 features soaring ceilings with double-height windows that flood the space with natural light, complemented by wide-plank light oak flooring throughout. The main level boasts a generous open-concept living and dining area, a well-appointed kitchen with stainless steel appliances, a corner gas fireplace, and a full bath. Tucked beneath the stairs is a perfect nook for a home office or workstation.  Upstairs, the mezzanine level includes an open bedroom with a walk-in closet, a second full bath, and in-unit laundry. One-car parking is included. Ideally located near Trader Joe's, Costco, Sightglass Coffee, Basil Thai, and within close proximity to major tech hubs like Airbnb, Pinterest, Open AI, Uber, and Square.
